title: crypto2dev_hmac_setkey_ctx leaks data buf on re-key
description:
In crypto2dev_hmac_setkey_ctx() (lines 1018-1022), when hmac->devCtx is non-NULL (re-key scenario), the code calls XMEMSET(hmac->devCtx, 0, sizeof(Crypto2DevHmacCtx)) before freeing the struct. This zeros the ctx->data pointer before it can be freed. If a streaming Update was in progress (ctx->data != NULL), the accumulation buffer is leaked.

Reproduction: wc_HmacSetKey (devId bound) → wc_HmacUpdate → wc_HmacSetKey again (re-key).

Fix: extract ctx->data/dataSz before XMEMSET, zero and free data first, then XMEMSET and XFREE the struct.

Affected code: wolfcrypt/src/port/crypto2dev/crypto2dev_port.c lines 1018-1022.
crypto2dev_free_hmac() has the same pattern but correct order (frees data first, then XMEMSET+XFREE the struct — see lines 1222-1229). The setkey path should mirror that.
